title: Lessons in Anatomy
timecode_note: Scene boundaries are editorial markers rounded to the nearest second; transitions overlap.

scenes.title: Above the water
scenes.composition: A small boat sits on the horizon above ridges of dark, heaving water.
scenes.movement_and_transition: The framing holds the horizon while the waves supply motion. The horizon gives way to an underwater view.
scenes.intention: Begin at a distance, with the boat small against the sea.

scenes.title: Below the surface
scenes.composition: The waterline leaves the top of the frame as the image opens into a dark underwater field.
scenes.movement_and_transition: The viewpoint descends through the surface and the first fish emerge below the lighter water.
scenes.intention: Make the change in viewpoint legible without breaking the journey.

scenes.title: The shoal
scenes.composition: Small fish are distributed through the water, with the light concentrated above them.
scenes.movement_and_transition: The shoal drifts across the frame. The jellyfish begins to emerge as the fish fall away.
scenes.intention: Let the viewer adjust to the underwater space before introducing the central creature.

scenes.title: The immortal jellyfish
scenes.composition: A rose-toned jellyfish holds the centre of dark water; “the first immortal creature” appears beneath it.
scenes.movement_and_transition: The bell and filaments move within a held composition. The heart overlaps as the text recedes.
scenes.intention: Give the animal time to register before turning to the poem’s question about mortality.

scenes.title: The anatomical heart
scenes.composition: The heart develops over the jellyfish before becoming the main image.
scenes.movement_and_transition: The silhouettes overlap. The red wash then begins to carry the anatomy study into the shore.
scenes.intention: Turn the question of immortality back towards bodily vulnerability.

scenes.title: Return to shore
scenes.composition: Bare feet and pale cloth emerge through the wash, with foam and reflections at the waterline.
scenes.movement_and_transition: The anatomical study dissolves into the shoreline. Moving foam carries the held shot until paper begins to rise.
scenes.intention: Bring the poem’s questions back to the body and give the encounter time to settle.

scenes.title: Unfinished business
scenes.composition: Paper and a soft illustrated waterline reveal the italic phrase “unfinished business”.
scenes.movement_and_transition: The shoreline recedes behind the paper. The words then fade before the title treatment settles.
scenes.intention: Let the unresolved phrase outlast the scene that prompted it.

scenes.title: The studio signature
scenes.composition: The Cold Feet Editions name and tagline sit on warm paper above the remaining water motif.
scenes.movement_and_transition: The closing composition holds through the end.
scenes.intention: Leave the viewer with a quiet studio signature after the poem’s final fragment.

comparisons.title: Horizon
comparisons.description: V2 used a small title against a quieter horizon. V5 gives the opening to a more textured, unsettled sea. The boat remains a point of scale.

comparisons.title: Jellyfish
comparisons.description: V2 uses a softly outlined bell and fine, straight filaments. V5 introduces a denser rose-toned study with longer curling forms, giving the viewer more to follow within the held shot.

comparisons.title: Shoreline
comparisons.description: V2 places drawn feet against layered graphic waves. V5 brings fabric, foam and reflections into the same textured scene, making the return to the body more immediate.
